results.title: Both providers discover US manufacturers, then deduplicate
results.detail: No strategy discovers from both providers in parallel (chainFor: every chain has ONE discovery step). Apify's discovery steps are signal-led (job search / post search) with no industry or firmographic filter, so 'manufacturers' with no signal cannot be discovered by Apify at all.

spec.providers: would need parallel discovery + firmographic Apify search (neither exists)

results.title: Hiring OR expansion opportunities
results.detail: either/or kept: false; expansion is a preference only; expansion limitation stated: false

hard: hiring AEs OR expansion (one either/or requirement)

spec.expected: hiring branch discovered and proven; expansion branch stated as a limitation, not silently dropped
spec.pass: the either/or requirement is preserved (not narrowed to hiring-only), the expansion limitation is stated
